question:
In the following triad, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

SINK - ISNK - KISN

PLAY - LPAY - YLPA
solution:
Given: 

SINK - ISNK - KISN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0084602657c9e05e0528b746127a4d521f2a64a5a3deb628454e96ae6b48c0d7.png] 

PLAY - LPAY - YLPA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10d5cd8e56869623716f5062b56a327fc3222d86b4403f06bb268812b0623b91.png] 

Let's check each option:

1. WAIT - WIAT - TIAW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e646ebadae29d19654f2fdbad7e07b55fa802f5dd6b66277117bb33337bed73d.png] 

This triad does not follow the same logic.

2. READ - ERAD - DERA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2810b5320837e323ad67818830428c1916d8f1028d39d292097da5091fa2edaf.png] 

This triad follows the same logic.

3. NAME - ANME - EAMN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e1850fcf131f2efe2e5fc9dd3f22d4d8055945ede963d2094c47a5f660b072a.png] 

This triad does not follow the same logic.

4. YOUR - OYUR - OURY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/619c4b662a1b231ec72e71124cf7f9e09ef630cb42a9ebfbb303caad58d00d71.png] 

This triad does not follow the same logic.

Thus, READ - ERAD - DERA follows the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
